title: Defining and building
caption: Every effort splits into defining what to make and building it. AI speeds up building. For defining it can only guess what is in your head, unless it asks.

defining.name: Defining
defining.aim: Deciding what to make. AI can assist by asking.
defining.bubble: “…as long as AI can’t read our minds.”

building.name: Building
building.aim: Making it. AI speeds it up a great deal.
building.footnote: More documents per hour at every station.
building.mapping: Defining is Sales and Design, building is Build to Delivery.

upfront.lead: Clients can’t state it up front:
upfront.text: they find out what they want by trying versions

survey.text: of 228 companies name incomplete or hidden requirements as their top problem

clients-cannot-state-it-up-front.header: Clients cannot state it up front
clients-cannot-state-it-up-front.description: Brooks holds that clients do not know what they want and cannot specify it completely and correctly before they have tried versions of the product, so refining requirements iteratively is what builders do most for them [1].

brooks-no-silver-bullet.title: Brooks, No Silver Bullet: Essence and Accidents of Software Engineering

practitioners-name-it-too.description: in a survey of 228 companies, incomplete or hidden requirements were the most cited requirements problem (48%), and avoidable rework is estimated at 40 to 50 percent of project effort, though the 100x late-fix rule and the CHAOS failure rates are disputed [1].

unclear-requirements-cause-rework.title: Why do unclear requirements lead to rework and failed projects? (earlier research file)

two-halves.title: Two halves
two-halves.script: Every effort splits into two halves, defining what to make and building it. AI speeds up building a great deal. For defining it can only guess what is in your head, unless it asks. On the line from before, defining is Sales and Design, and building is Build to Delivery.

foreshadow.title: Foreshadow
foreshadow.script: Remember that last thought, because it comes back. Defining is exactly where the AI can help, by asking you questions the way a good interviewer would. That has a name, meta prompting, and we get to it in the last Section.
